Hi Liam,

Thanks for agreeing to get set up with Redwood. To move procurement and PO issuance forward we need the following items to complete your vendor file:

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing Commercial General Liability (GL), Errors & Omissions (E&O), and Cyber liability. Please include policy limits and effective/expiry dates.
- Completed vendor onboarding form (link below) or equivalent company details (legal entity name, TAX ID/EIN, remittance address).
- W-9 (for US entities) or equivalent tax form.
- Primary billing contact and billing email for PO/invoice routing.

Our basic COI requirements are: GL $1,000,000 each occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate; E&O $1,000,000; Cyber $1,000,000. Please add "Redwood Inference, Inc." as certificate holder and include our address: 123 Market St., San Francisco, CA 94105. If you anticipate different limits, flag those now so we can route to finance/insurance.

Once we have the COI and W-9, our vendor setup team will create the vendor record and issue a PO. Estimated turnaround after receipt is 3-5 business days.

Onboarding form: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/clearedtech-onboarding
HubSpot ref: HS-40712

If you can send the docs today, Monica (cc'd) will triage them on the procurement side.

Thanks,

Evelyn Hart
